what_to_detect: A resolution acting through the Saddle keyword's line makes its permanent saddled: the permanent carries the saddled designation after the resolution, the cost half having tapped other creatures whose total power meets the saddle number.
near_miss: A Saddle resolution after which the permanent is not saddled.
record_fields: state.entities[].designations 'saddled' (gen-3) in the snapshots before and after the resolution
note: Saddle is Forge's AlterAttribute (Attributes$ Saddle); ApiEvents has no AlterAttribute rule, so no state_flag_change with flag saddled is ever written: the outcome shows only as the snapshot designation.
